name: ROI-based Attenuation of Unimportant Structures
definition: A technique to attenuate unimportant high-intensity structures (e.g., at the brain surface) by defining a spherical Region of Interest (ROI) around a Point of Interest (POI) in the tumor tissue.
summary: ROI-based Attenuation of Unimportant Structures uses a spherical region of interest to blend or attenuate voxels, distinguishing itself from axis-aligned clipping by reducing visual clutter around a specific point of interest.
